name: qr-code-assemble
description: Every module of a QR code flies out of a button on its own curved path and settles into its cell, as thin bars (Fan) or fine dust (Dust). Click to rebuild.

name: photo-stack-lightbox
description: A stack of photo cards spreads into a scattered, tilted gallery; a card flies to a centred lightbox with its caption while the rest blur and fade.

name: garden-progress-slider
description: Progress slider where a garden grows along the track: flowers sprout and bloom as the value rises, drop their petals as it falls, and a bee follows the head.

name: holo-flip-badge
description: Lanyard ID badge that hangs from a cord, sways, tilts toward the pointer and flips on click to a holographic profile on the back.

name: bookshelf-cover-flip
description: A row of book spines on a shelf; the hovered book turns out to show its cover, and the shelf cycles through them when left alone.

name: app-icon-paddle-wheel
description: A paddle wheel of thick app-icon tiles turning about a vertical axis; drag to spin it, press to speed it up, and it leans toward the pointer.

name: bloom-wave-text
description: A word that a wave of tiny flowers sweeps across, left to right: the ink gives way to blooms and comes back behind them. Hover blooms the flowers near the pointer; click replays the sweep.

name: swinging-lanyard-badge
description: An ID badge on a lanyard: elastic straps meet in a sewn end, and a split ring hooks through the sleeve's slot. Grab the card to swing, pull or throw it; it leans toward the pointer and stays still until touched.

name: draggable-cloth-print
description: A paper print simulated as Verlet cloth: a ghost hand picks it up, folds, carries, twists and drops it, and you can grab it yourself.

name: agent-status
description: What an agent is doing now: idle, working, needs input, or failed. Active states pulse.

name: alert
description: An inline message that stays until dismissed, with four severities and an optional action. Errors are announced immediately.

tweakSchema.label: Description
tweakSchema.default: Add a payment method to keep your projects and deploys running.

name: approval-card
description: Asks the user to approve or reject an agent action before it runs, with a risk level. The choice can be changed until the agent acts.

tweakSchema.label: Action
tweakSchema.default: Email 214 customers about the price change

tweakSchema.label: Details
tweakSchema.default: Subject: Your plan is changing on Nov 1. Sent from billing@acme.com. Recipients are every customer on the Team plan.

name: badge
description: Small status label with five tones and an optional dot.

name: bouncing-dot-tabs
description: A row of filter tabs where a dot is thrown in an arc to the tab you pick, stretching in the air and squashing on landing while the gap it sits in moves with it. A demo pointer clicks the tabs until you take over.

name: button
description: Primary, secondary, ghost, and destructive buttons. Loading keeps the label in place and blocks repeat clicks.

name: card
description: Container with an eyebrow, title, body, and footer. Turn on interactive when the whole card is a link.

tweakSchema.label: Body
tweakSchema.default: Unlimited projects, shared environment variables, and audit history for every member.

name: carousel
description: Draggable slides with arrows, dots, and keyboard support. Autoplay is off by default and always has a pause button.

name: chat-thread
description: Scrollable conversation that follows new messages and offers Jump to latest when the reader scrolls up.

name: checkbox
description: Native checkbox, restyled, with an animated checkmark, an indeterminate state, and an optional description.

tweakSchema.label: Description
tweakSchema.default: You can change this later in settings.

name: data-table
description: A sortable table with row selection. Headers expose sort state, and the selection count is announced.

name: dialog
description: Modal with a title, body, and two actions. Traps focus, closes on Escape, and returns focus to its trigger.

tweakSchema.label: Body
tweakSchema.default: The project, its deploys, and its environment variables are removed for everyone on the team. This can't be undone.

name: diff-review
description: Accept or reject an agent's proposed changes hunk by hunk or all at once, with undo until the result is applied.

name: dropdown-menu
description: A button that opens a list of actions. Arrow keys, Home, End, and type-ahead move through items; Escape returns focus.

name: image-viewer
description: Thumbnails that open a full-screen viewer with zoom, arrow-key navigation, and focus that returns where it started.

name: liquid-glass-clock
description: A clock built from glass tubes: glowing liquid runs along the hands and markers while a needle sweeps. Runs as a loader, the device time, or a set time; the liquid leans toward the pointer.

name: message-bubble
description: One chat message. The user's sits in a raised bubble, the assistant's reads as plain text. Copy confirms in place.

tweakSchema.label: Text
tweakSchema.default: Revenue is up 12% on the quarter, led by the enterprise tier. Churn fell to 2.1%, the lowest it has been this year.

name: photo-card-globe
description: A sphere of product photo cards turns around a fixed 3D word, with cards passing in front of it. Drag to spin it, hover to lean it toward the pointer.

name: status-dot-picker
description: An avatar's status dot grows into a three-button pill on hover, a tooltip names the hovered status, and a pick squeezes the pill back into a dot of that colour.

name: water-ripple-refraction
description: Concentric water rings flow out of the bottom of a painting, bending the picture as they pass, with a soft rim and shade on each swell. Swap in your own image.

name: page-flip-book
description: A picture book seen face-on: single leaves hinge about the spine in real perspective, each back carrying the next spread, and the book closes onto its centred cover. Click the edges or drag a page to turn it.

name: plan-list
description: An agent's planned steps with done, running, and pending states and a progress bar.

name: pricing-table
description: Plans side by side with a monthly and annual switch, a highlighted plan, and stacking on narrow widths.

name: prompt-composer
description: Prompt box that grows with its content. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line, and send becomes stop while running.

name: reasoning-trace
description: The steps an agent took, folded away by default, with how long each took.

name: scroll-area
description: A fixed-height scrolling list with edge fades that appear only when there is more to see.

name: segmented-control
description: Compact single choice from two to five options, with arrow-key navigation and a sliding selection.

name: sign-in-form
description: A sign-in or sign-up form with field validation that explains itself and focuses the first error.

name: split-pane
description: Two panes with a draggable divider that also works from the keyboard, horizontally or stacked.

name: streaming-text
description: Reveals a reply word by word like a streamed answer. Respects reduced motion.

tweakSchema.label: Text
tweakSchema.default: Revenue grew 12% quarter over quarter, led by the enterprise tier. Churn fell to 2.1%, the lowest this year, mostly from fewer failed payments.

name: suggestion-chips
description: Follow-up prompts shown under an agent reply. Picking one marks it.

name: stretch-pill-toggle
description: A pill toggle whose knob stretches toward where it is going, with a Plain / Stretch segmented control to compare it against a rigid slide. Click the track to toggle.

name: switch
description: On and off setting with a label and description. The whole row is the click target.

tweakSchema.label: Description
tweakSchema.default: Get a summary when a deploy finishes.

name: tabs
description: Underlined tabs with one panel each. Arrow keys, Home, and End move between tabs.

name: terminal-output
description: A command's output with an exit status in words, streaming lines, auto-follow, and copy.

name: text-input
description: Text field with a visible label, helper text, and an error state. Password fields get a show and hide toggle.

tweakSchema.label: Helper
tweakSchema.default: We only use this to send your receipts.

name: toast
description: Notification with a title and detail. Dismisses itself, pauses on hover and focus, and announces errors.

tweakSchema.label: Detail
tweakSchema.default: Reload to get the latest changes.

name: tool-call-card
description: One tool call with its status, duration, input, and result. Folds open and closed.

name: tooltip
description: A short text label for a control. Opens after a hover delay or instantly on keyboard focus, and closes on Escape.

name: distribution-chart
description: Glowing area curves on a shared grid with a soft reflection. Compare a concentrated result with a spread-out one, side by side or overlaid, and read both at the same position.

name: card-swap
description: Stacked 3D deck where the front card slides out and drops to the back with spring motion.

name: spiral-3d-slider
description: Items on a 3D helix that you turn by dragging, scrolling or arrow keys; the nearest item snaps to the front with a spring.

name: like
description: Like button with a springy press, a seeded particle burst in the accent colour and a rolling count.

name: wake-slider
description: Tick slider where a trailing wake of magnification follows the pointer as you drag.

name: rolling-counter
description: Number stepper pill with odometer digits that roll in the direction of change, hold to repeat with acceleration and keyboard control.

name: dock
description: Frosted glass dock whose icons magnify with a smooth falloff as the pointer moves.

name: tilt
description: Card that tilts in 3D toward the pointer with a moving glare and layered depth.

tweakSchema.label: Subtitle
tweakSchema.default: Move your pointer across the card

name: liq-toggle
description: Gooey switch whose thumb stretches into the track like a drop of liquid and settles with a spring.

name: orbit-card-stack
description: Cards travelling around a tilted elliptical orbit with depth, slow autoplay, drag with inertia and click to bring a card to the front.

name: label-input
description: Text field with a floating label that springs up on focus, helper and error text, a leading hint and a password reveal.

tweakSchema.label: Helper
tweakSchema.default: We will only use it to send your receipt.

name: one-time-code
description: Verification code input with auto-advance, paste, springy digits and a demo success or shake-and-error result.

name: seek
description: Media scrubber with buffered segment, hover time preview and a simulated play button.

name: snap-carousel
description: Swipeable carousel with momentum, spring snapping, scaled neighbours and a stretching pill indicator.

name: glass-carousel
description: Endless draggable row of panels passing under a fixed frosted glass lens that refracts them, with a click to focus view.

name: coverflow-drag
description: Drag-first coverflow of tilted cards on a perspective stage with momentum, spring snapping, click-to-centre and an optional reflection.

name: text-repel
description: Large text whose letters spring away from the pointer inside a radius and settle back when it leaves.

name: letter-cascade
description: Text whose letters cascade in and out with a staggered spring in four modes, looping and replaying on hover.

name: magnetic-dock
description: Floating icon bar whose buttons are pulled toward the pointer with springs, with a stretching bar and a label chip.

name: layered-stack
description: Stack of glass layers that fan out with a staggered spring on hover so every title is readable, and click to bring a layer to the front.

name: signature
description: Signature pad with smoothed, speed-sensitive strokes, undo, clear and a replay that writes the signature back out.

name: accordionos
description: OS-style numbered accordion with a step counter, progress bar, springy height and generated thumbnails.

name: corner-video
description: Floating mini video player that you drag and it springs to the nearest corner, with hover controls, expand and close.

name: dynamic-grid-gallery
description: Tile gallery where the hovered tile's row and column grow on a spring while the rest shrink, and a click pins it.

name: infinite-grid
description: Drag-to-pan infinite canvas of generated cards that tiles in every direction, with inertia and a centre falloff.

name: inline-edit
description: Click-to-edit text with a spring-sized input, pencil hint, saved flash and an undo chip, single line or multiline.

name: gooey-delete-confirm
description: A round trash button that splits into Confirm and Cancel pills through one smooth, gooey silhouette, and flows back together on Cancel. Click the trash to open it; click Cancel to close it.

name: scribble-loop-nav
description: A hand-drawn loop circles the hovered menu item and travels along one continuous stroke, through the labels and into the next loop, when the item changes.

name: crumple-paper-carousel
description: Posters lie flat in the centre and crumple into faceted paper balls as they slide away. Scroll, swipe, or let it step on its own.

name: mirror-flip-carousel
description: Cards on a track that flip 180° per slot, flaring out to the frame edges in a wide-angle barrel warp with a chromatic fringe. Drag, use the arrows, or let it autoplay.

name: button-morph-card
description: A pill button that grows into a card and shrinks back through one morphing container. The label glides into the card's title slot and the body fades in with a blur. Built-in flight card and confirm dialog.

name: flip-invite-ticket
description: A capsule that tilts and swaps from an invite-ready button to a code with a COPY button, while a header label flips up on its hinge above it.

name: pixel-swarm-dropdown
description: A select whose menu assembles out of a swarm of square pixel cells in the chosen option's colour, then bursts back into the pill while the label scrambles into the new name.

name: holo-card-dispenser
description: A holographic membership card is issued out of a card reader's slot, its foil sheen follows the pointer, and pressing the button retracts it and issues it again.

tweakSchema.label: Body
tweakSchema.default: Download packs and assets, insert them in Figma with the plugin, or let your AI agent fetch them over MCP.

name: scroll-progress-outline
description: An 'On this page' outline whose arrow rides the connecting path as the page scrolls, and walks itself down the outline on a loop when autoplay is on.

name: peel-sticker
description: Any PNG or SVG as a die-cut vinyl sticker: drag an edge to peel it back over a rolled crease that shows the printed liner, let go and it springs flat. The pointer sweeps a holographic fringe along the border.

tweakSchema.label: Caption
tweakSchema.default: Drag an edge to peel · move over it for the shine

name: radial-action-menu
description: A round + button that sends six icon buttons flying in along radial spokes, blurred and fading in clockwise from the top, and flings them back out on ×. Buttons swell toward the pointer like drops of liquid.

name: range-switch-stat-card
description: A stat card with a 7d / 12d / 30d range switch: the thumb glides, the line chart morphs left to right, and the numbers count to their new values. Hover the chart for a day tooltip and a gentle tilt.

name: licorice-glide
description: A liquorice-black toolbar of line icons with one tooltip that glides between them: the tag's width eases to each label while the words scroll through it, then fades out where it stopped.

name: periwinkle-fanfare
description: A dark Submit pill that turns to loading dots, then springs back with a burst of tumbling paper confetti and a drawn-in Success check. Tap to run it.
